title: Algo trading result so far
author: Suthekingg
selftext:
Ok so last few months I’m working on building an algo called Market Sentinel, so far testing out 10-15 strat on demo and 3 on real propfirm challenge (cheaper ones since still not  
Proven) here is the result so far of the main strat.. it’s only 27 trades is about 3-4 months so can be pure luck .. will judge after couple of months.. still good to see..

comments.author: AoideusWasBanned
comments.body: Respect for saying 27 trades could be luck, most people wouldn't. Out of the 10-15 strategies you tested on demo, is this the best one? Just curious how much picking is behind it.

replies.author: Suthekingg
replies.body:
This one is the first Strat, I just automated it based on my own manual trading experience, and other 10+ Strat running now  
Are just known Strats from difference sources with semi decent backtest results after cost so I’m running them  
On demo with some quirks to see if any of them is worth adding on real account .. and the result one is just the first and main one that has been working  
For me in manual trades , but sadly after backtesting seems bedore 2021 it was be or slightly losing but I don’t wanna judge it based in weaker pre 2021 results , I use points a lot instead of % so it could also be since price was lot less for nq back it 2020 the results aren’t right.. I will try to do few other tests to see if the weaker pre 2021 is right or this Strat just waiting in 2025-2026 more of fully regime dependent .. I think live result carries higjest value and so far it’s outperforming  
The  
Backtest results so I wil wait 50-100 live trades and see how it goes but with this trading frequency I’m expecting at least 1  
Year to collect enough data

replies.author: AoideusWasBanned
replies.body:
The points thing might be a big part of it tbh. NQ was way lower back then, so a fixed point stop or target means something very different in 2020 than now.

I'd rerun it with stops and targets as % or ATR multiples before deciding it's a regime thing. Good luck with the live run, a year is a long wait but worth it.
